records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. MARCH 31, 2022
records.text: •SaaS and license revenue increased 15% to $123.2 million during the three months ended March 31, 2022 from $107.4 million during the three months ended March 31, 2021.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. MARCH 31, 2022
records.text: SaaS and license revenue represented 60% of our revenue during the three months ended March 31, 2022, as compared to 62% in the same period in the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. MARCH 31, 2022
records.text: Software license revenue represented 3% of our revenue during the three months ended March 31, 2022, as compared to 5% for the same period in the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. MARCH 31, 2022
records.text: Our net income attributable to common stockholders increased $2.0 million during the three months ended March 31, 2022 as a result of adopting ASU 2020-06 due to no longer recording non-cash interest expense related to the amortization of the debt discount associated with the previous equity component of the 2026 Notes.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. MARCH 31, 2022
records.text: For the three months ended March 31, 2022, cash flows used in operating activities were $14.0 million, compared to cash flows from operating activities of $21.2 million for the same period in the prior year.
